title: 8 Things a Godly Man's Work Builds in Him That His Resume Never Will
caption:
None of these show up in a performance review.

The discipline to start before he feels like it. The patience to do the boring rep for the tenth time. The humility to take correction from someone younger. The honesty to say "I don't know yet." The endurance to finish what stopped being fun months ago. The self-control to do it right when no one's auditing him, because Colossians calls it working as for the Lord, not for the boss watching. The character that outlasts the title. The gratitude to call it a gift, not a grind.

The job changes. Who it made him doesn't.
